title: Quarterly Ops Runway: Hosted Route Prioritization & Model Rotation Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Create an operational playbook and quarterly plan that aligns hosted API route prioritization, model rotation windows, and release guardrails so product teams can predict cost, latency, and quality trade-offs during the next quarter.

Background: Over the last two quarters we observed mismatched cadence between model rollouts and route-level SLOs. Some high-traffic routes were rotated with minimal canary coverage and caused regressions (see datadog anomaly in links). This ticket produces an explicit, repeatable runway that: (1) ranks routes by business-criticality and cost impact, (2) maps model variant families to rotation windows, (3) defines canary and rollback thresholds, and (4) surfaces tooling and dashboards required for safe automation.

Scope:
- Deliver a prioritized matrix of hosted API routes (top 50 by token spend + strategic routes) with recommended rotation cadence.
- Define rotation templates: canary length, traffic percentage, metric thresholds (latency/quality/cost).
- Produce a release checklist and escalation path for rotations (including who to page and rollback steps).
- Identify and schedule Console UX changes required to show per-route rotation status and canary health.
- Produce a short runbook for Dedicated/Private customers with additional gating and approval steps.

Out of scope: Automated rollout orchestration implementation (ENG follow-up), deep model tuning for individual anomalies (handled by model owners).

Deliverables:
- Prioritization spreadsheet (Drive) with recommended cadence and justification.
- Playbook doc with templates and checklist.
- PRD for Console visibility changes (link).
- Risk & dependency register for Q2 rotations.

Stakeholders: PM (Aisha), Product Ops, Runtime SRE, Model Owners, Console UX, Sales (customer impact coordination).
success_metrics: Reduce mean time-to-rollback for rotation regressions to under 15 minutes
Model rotation lead time (proposal -> full rollout) under 3 weeks for prioritized routes
95th percentile request latency for prioritized routes below 120ms post-rotation
No more than one customer-visible regression across prioritized routes per quarter
acceptance_criteria: Prioritization matrix populated for top 50 routes with clear justification and owner
Playbook published in Drive with checklist templates and escalation contacts
Console PRD reviewed and accepted by Console PM and UX
Dependencies and ENG tickets created for automation/observability work
risks: Insufficient observability for some low-traffic but high-value routes (may require extra instrumentation)
Competing eng bandwidth in same cycle (autoscaling and KV cache work scheduled)
Customer pushback on rotation frequency for Dedicated customers with strict validation windows
decisions_required: Rotation frequency buckets (weekly / biweekly / monthly) for each priority tier
Canary thresholds for automated rollback (latency, error-rate, semantic-quality signals)
Whether we require manual stakeholder sign-off for any route in the top priority tier
